description: Example input/output pairs for WAN 2.5 prompt generation. Each example shows structured shot data (input) converted to both human-readable description and structured JSON (output). Examples span multiple project types to demonstrate versatility.

examples.title: Film Noir — Establishing Shot with Audio
examples.notes: Demonstrates the full 4-Dimensional formula with all audio layers. Film noir aesthetic with atmospheric mood. Uses quality_mode='off' for hero shot quality.

input.description: Opening establishing shot of the detective's office building at night. Rain. Neon signs. 1940s period.
input.continuity_notes: First shot of the film. Establishes visual tone for entire project.

output.human_readable: A wide establishing shot of a 1940s downtown office building at night. Heavy rain cascades past glowing neon signs — red and amber — their light pooling in reflections across the wet pavement. Steam rises from a manhole cover in the foreground. The building's third-floor window glows with a single warm light behind frosted glass. The camera slowly dollies in from across the street, gradually tightening the frame toward the lit window. Sound: Rain hammering on metal awnings, distant thunder rolling, a muted trumpet melody drifting from a nearby club.

json.prompt: A wide shot of a 1940s downtown office building exterior at night, heavy rain cascading past glowing neon signs in red and amber, light pooling in reflections across wet pavement. Steam rises from a manhole cover in the foreground. A single warm light glows behind frosted glass on the third floor. Camera slowly dollies in from across the street toward the lit window. Film noir aesthetic, high contrast lighting, deep shadows. Rain hammering on metal awnings, distant thunder, muted trumpet melody from a nearby club.
json.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted, flickering, low quality, watermark, modern elements, cars, daylight, bright colors, cartoon

audio_description.sfx: Heavy rain hammering on metal awnings, distant thunder rolling slowly
audio_description.music: Muted trumpet melody, smoky jazz, drifting from a nearby club

examples.title: Music Video — Performance Shot with Dynamic Camera
examples.notes: Demonstrates energetic camera work for a music video performance. Uses orbit movement for dynamism. Audio focuses on music + ambient SFX. Higher guidance for precise choreography.

input.description: Lead singer performing in an abandoned warehouse. Neon light bars scattered around. Energetic, confident body language.

characters.name: Mira
characters.description: Lead vocalist, early 20s, shaved head, silver earrings, black leather jacket over mesh top, combat boots
characters.action: Singing directly to camera with confident, aggressive energy

input.continuity_notes: Warehouse set appears in shots 2-7. Same neon color scheme (magenta, cyan, amber). Mira's wardrobe consistent throughout.

output.human_readable: A medium shot of a young woman with a shaved head and silver earrings, wearing a black leather jacket over a mesh top. She stands in an abandoned industrial warehouse, performing with fierce, confident energy — chin raised, one hand gripping an unseen microphone. Scattered neon light bars in magenta, cyan, and amber cast dramatic colored shadows across concrete walls. The camera orbits slowly around her from left to right, catching lens flares from the neon sources. Pulsing electronic bass, muffled echoes bouncing off warehouse walls.

json.prompt: Medium shot of a young woman with a shaved head and silver earrings, black leather jacket over mesh top, standing in an abandoned industrial warehouse. She performs with fierce confident energy, chin raised, one hand gripping a microphone. Neon light bars in magenta, cyan, and amber cast dramatic colored shadows across concrete walls and dusty floor. Camera slowly orbits around her from left to right, catching lens flares from the neon sources. Electric, rebellious mood. Music video aesthetic, high energy.
json.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted, flickering, low quality, watermark, static pose, dull lighting, daylight, clean modern interior

audio_description.sfx: Muffled echoes bouncing off warehouse walls, faint hum of neon lights
audio_description.music: Pulsing electronic bass, driving beat, dark synth atmosphere

examples.title: Sci-Fi Short — Image-to-Video Character Animation
examples.notes: Demonstrates image-to-video mode where the prompt focuses ONLY on motion and camera — the source image defines the character's appearance. Audio disabled for a silent atmospheric shot. Uses enhance_prompt=false for precise control.

input.description: Close-up of Captain Reva reading a holographic display. Her eyes track data scrolling across the display. Subtle light play from the hologram on her face.

characters.name: Captain Reva
characters.description: Mid-40s, South Asian, grey-streaked dark hair pulled back, angular features, cybernetic implant visible at left temple
characters.action: Eyes scanning holographic data, slight narrowing of eyes as she reads something concerning

input.continuity_notes: Source image already approved as Continuity Anchor for Captain Reva. Use image-to-video to preserve exact appearance. Holographic blue-green light palette established in shots 8-11.

output.human_readable: Starting from the approved reference frame of Captain Reva at her command station. Her eyes slowly track from left to right, following data scrolling across an unseen holographic display. Her expression subtly shifts — a slight narrowing of the eyes, jaw tightening — as she reads something troubling. Holographic blue-green light flickers gently across her face, casting shifting shadows. Camera holds static — fixed shot, no movement. The only motion is her eye movement, facial micro-expressions, and the dancing holographic light reflections.

json.prompt: The character's eyes slowly track from left to right, following data on an unseen holographic display. Expression subtly shifts, eyes narrowing slightly, jaw tightening as she reads something troubling. Holographic blue-green light flickers gently across her face, casting shifting shadows. Static shot, fixed camera, no movement. Subtle facial micro-expressions, dancing holographic light reflections on skin.
json.negative_prompt: blurry, distorted, flickering, camera movement, zoom, pan, full body shot, different face, different clothing

examples.title: Commercial — Product Beauty Shot with Precise Camera
examples.notes: Demonstrates a polished commercial/product shot. Clean aesthetic with controlled lighting. Uses higher guidance_scale (7.0) for precision. 10-second duration for a smooth, complete camera move around the product.

input.description: Hero product shot of the Aurelia perfume bottle. Rotating beauty shot on reflective surface. Luxury aesthetic.
input.continuity_notes: Bottle design: tall rectangular glass with gold cap, amber liquid, 'AURELIA' embossed in gold serif font. Consistent with brand color palette: black, gold, amber.

output.human_readable: A ten-second beauty shot of a tall rectangular glass perfume bottle with a gold cap, filled with amber liquid, sitting on a polished black reflective surface. The word 'AURELIA' is embossed in gold serif lettering on the glass. Studio lighting: a single key light from above-right creates a clean specular highlight down the bottle's edge, with a soft fill from the left. The background is a seamless dark gradient. The camera orbits smoothly and slowly around the bottle through a complete 180-degree arc, revealing the embossed text and the amber liquid catching the light from different angles. Audio: subtle crystalline chime, soft ambient drone, elegant and minimal.

json.prompt: Close-up of a tall rectangular glass perfume bottle with a gold cap, filled with amber liquid, the word AURELIA embossed in gold serif lettering. Bottle sits on a polished black reflective surface. Single key light from above-right creates a clean specular highlight along the bottle's edge, soft fill from left. Seamless dark gradient background. Camera orbits smoothly and slowly around the bottle through a 180-degree arc, revealing the embossed text and amber liquid catching light from different angles. Luxury product photography, studio lighting, minimalist elegance.

examples.title: Documentary — Interview Setup with Dialogue
examples.notes: Demonstrates dialogue/voice audio in a realistic documentary setting. Static camera for interview framing. Uses moderate guidance for natural, less-controlled feel. Audio includes spoken dialogue.

input.description: Interview with elderly fisherman in his workshop. He speaks about the old days. Warm, nostalgic. Documentary interview framing.

characters.name: Hiro
characters.description: Elderly Japanese fisherman, late 70s, deeply weathered face, white stubble, worn blue work shirt, calloused hands
characters.action: Speaking to an interviewer off-camera, gesturing gently with one hand, warm expression

scene_context.weather: n/a (interior, but warm light suggests clear day outside)

input.dialogue: The sea remembers everything. Every storm, every calm morning.
input.continuity_notes: Workshop background consistent across interview shots 6-12. Fishing nets, wooden tools, and a small window with afternoon light visible behind Hiro.

output.human_readable: A medium close-up of an elderly Japanese fisherman in his late 70s, deeply weathered face with white stubble, wearing a worn blue work shirt. He sits in his fishing workshop surrounded by nets, wooden tools, and coiled rope. Warm afternoon sunlight streams through a small window behind him, backlighting wisps of dust in the air. He speaks to someone off-camera with a gentle, knowing expression, gesturing slowly with one calloused hand. The camera holds perfectly still in documentary interview framing. Shallow depth of field softens the workshop background. Audio: His voice speaking warmly, 'The sea remembers everything. Every storm, every calm morning.' Ambient workshop sounds — faint creaking of wood, distant seabirds outside.

json.prompt: Medium close-up of an elderly Japanese fisherman in his late 70s with deeply weathered face and white stubble, wearing a worn blue work shirt. He sits in a fishing workshop surrounded by nets, wooden tools, and coiled rope. Warm afternoon sunlight streams through a small window behind him, backlighting dust in the air. He speaks to someone off-camera with a gentle knowing expression, gesturing slowly with one calloused hand. Fixed shot, static camera, documentary interview framing. Shallow depth of field, warm tones, natural light, intimate mood.

examples.title: Fantasy Short — Action Sequence with Dynamic Camera
examples.notes: Demonstrates an action-oriented shot with fast camera movement. Uses 5-second duration to keep quality high despite dynamic motion. Limited to 2 clear actions. Aesthetic control keywords for fantasy genre.

input.description: The knight charges across the stone bridge toward the enemy. Cloak billowing. Sword raised. We push in fast as she closes the distance.

characters.name: Ser Kael
characters.description: Female knight, mid-30s, scarred face, silver-streaked dark hair tied back, battered plate armor with a crimson cloak, longsword
characters.action: Running at full sprint across a stone bridge, crimson cloak billowing behind, longsword raised overhead

scene_context.location: Exterior — Ancient stone bridge over a misty gorge

input.continuity_notes: Bridge established in wide shot (shot 17). Ser Kael's armor and cloak consistent with character sheet. Dawn lighting with golden rim light from camera-right.

output.human_readable: Wide shot rapidly pushing in to medium: A female knight in battered plate armor and a crimson cloak sprints at full speed across an ancient stone bridge. Thick mist rises from the gorge below, curling around the bridge's weathered pillars. Her silver-streaked dark hair streams behind her as the cloak billows dramatically. She raises a longsword overhead as she charges. Dawn light breaks through the mist from camera-right, creating a golden rim light along her armor's edges. The camera pushes in quickly from a wide establishing angle to a medium shot as she closes the distance, building urgency. Audio: Heavy armored footsteps pounding stone, cloak snapping in the wind, the metallic ring of armor plates, a rising orchestral swell.

json.prompt: Wide shot pushing in to medium: A female knight in battered plate armor with a crimson cloak sprints across an ancient stone bridge. Thick mist rises from a gorge below, curling around weathered stone pillars. Silver-streaked dark hair streams behind her, crimson cloak billowing dramatically. She raises a longsword overhead as she charges forward. Dawn light breaks through mist from camera-right, golden rim light along armor edges. Camera pushes in quickly from wide to medium shot, building urgency. Epic fantasy, cinematic, dramatic lighting, golden hour mist.
